SELECT SUM(`l_extendedprice` * (1 - `l_discount`)) AS revenue
FROM `samples`.`tpch`.`lineitem`
WHERE `l_shipinstruct` ILIKE '%DELIVER IN PERSON%'
  AND `l_shipdate` >= DATE('1996-01-01')
  AND `l_shipdate` < DATE('1997-01-01')
  AND `l_returnflag` != 'R'
  AND `l_shipinstruct` IS NOT NULL
  AND `l_shipdate` IS NOT NULL
  AND `l_extendedprice` IS NOT NULL
  AND `l_discount` IS NOT NULL;

WITH clerk_revenue AS (
  SELECT 
    o.o_clerk,
    SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue
  FROM `samples`.`tpch`.`orders` o
  JOIN `samples`.`tpch`.`lineitem` l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
  WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE('1995-01-01')
    AND o.o_orderdate < DATE('1996-01-01')
    AND l.l_returnflag != 'R'
    AND o.o_clerk IS NOT NULL
    AND l.l_extendedprice IS NOT NULL
    AND l.l_discount IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY o.o_clerk
)
SELECT o_clerk, revenue
FROM (
  SELECT o_clerk, revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS rnk
  FROM clerk_revenue
)
WHERE rnk <= 5

SELECT SUM(`l_extendedprice` * (1 - `l_discount`)) AS revenue
FROM `samples`.`tpch`.`lineitem`
WHERE `l_discount` = 0.10
  AND `l_shipdate` IS NOT NULL
  AND `l_shipdate` >= DATE('1994-01-01')
  AND `l_shipdate` < DATE('1995-01-01')
  AND `l_returnflag` IS NOT NULL
  AND `l_returnflag` != 'R'

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', `orders`.`o_orderdate`) AS order_year, SUM(`lineitem`.`l_extendedprice` * (1 - `lineitem`.`l_discount`)) AS revenue
FROM `samples`.`tpch`.`orders`
JOIN `samples`.`tpch`.`lineitem` ON `orders`.`o_orderkey` = `lineitem`.`l_orderkey`
WHERE `lineitem`.`l_returnflag` != 'R' AND `orders`.`o_orderdate` IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', `orders`.`o_orderdate`)
ORDER BY order_year ASC

SELECT SUM(`l_extendedprice` * (1 - `l_discount`)) AS revenue
FROM `samples`.`tpch`.`lineitem`
WHERE `l_receiptdate` IS NOT NULL
  AND `l_shipdate` IS NOT NULL
  AND DATEDIFF(`l_receiptdate`, `l_shipdate`) > 20
  AND `l_returnflag` != 'R'

SELECT `customer`.`c_mktsegment`, SUM(`lineitem`.`l_extendedprice` * (1 - `lineitem`.`l_discount`)) AS revenue
FROM `samples`.`tpch`.`customer`
JOIN `samples`.`tpch`.`orders` ON `customer`.`c_custkey` = `orders`.`o_custkey`
JOIN `samples`.`tpch`.`lineitem` ON `orders`.`o_orderkey` = `lineitem`.`l_orderkey`
WHERE `customer`.`c_acctbal` > 9000
  AND `lineitem`.`l_returnflag` != 'R'
  AND `customer`.`c_mktsegment` IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY `customer`.`c_mktsegment`

SELECT SUM(`lineitem`.`l_extendedprice` * (1 - `lineitem`.`l_discount`)) AS revenue FROM `samples`.`tpch`.`lineitem` JOIN `samples`.`tpch`.`orders` ON `lineitem`.`l_orderkey` = `orders`.`o_orderkey` JOIN `samples`.`tpch`.`customer` ON `orders`.`o_custkey` = `customer`.`c_custkey` JOIN `samples`.`tpch`.`part` ON `lineitem`.`l_partkey` = `part`.`p_partkey` WHERE `lineitem`.`l_shipmode` LIKE '%FOB%' AND `customer`.`c_mktsegment` = 'MACHINERY' AND `lineitem`.`l_returnflag` != 'R'

SELECT n.n_name AS nation, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue
FROM `samples`.`tpch`.`lineitem` l
JOIN `samples`.`tpch`.`orders` o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
JOIN `samples`.`tpch`.`customer` c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
JOIN `samples`.`tpch`.`nation` n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
JOIN `samples`.`tpch`.`region` r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
WHERE r.r_name ILIKE '%AFRICA%'
  AND l.l_returnflag != 'R'
  AND l.l_shipdate >= DATE('1994-01-01')
  AND l.l_shipdate < DATE('1995-01-01')
  AND n.n_name IS NOT NULL
  AND l.l_shipdate IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY n.n_name
ORDER BY revenue DESC;

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('DAY', `lineitem`.`l_shipdate`) AS ship_date, SUM(`lineitem`.`l_extendedprice` * (1 - `lineitem`.`l_discount`)) AS revenue
FROM `samples`.`tpch`.`orders`
JOIN `samples`.`tpch`.`lineitem` ON `orders`.`o_orderkey` = `lineitem`.`l_orderkey`
WHERE `orders`.`o_orderpriority` ILIKE '%5-LOW%'
  AND `lineitem`.`l_shipmode` ILIKE '%RAIL%'
  AND `lineitem`.`l_returnflag` != 'R'
  AND `lineitem`.`l_shipdate` IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('DAY', `lineitem`.`l_shipdate`)
ORDER BY ship_date

SELECT `part`.`p_type`, SUM(`lineitem`.`l_extendedprice` * (1 - `lineitem`.`l_discount`)) AS revenue
FROM `samples`.`tpch`.`lineitem`
JOIN `samples`.`tpch`.`part` ON `lineitem`.`l_partkey` = `part`.`p_partkey`
WHERE `part`.`p_type` ILIKE '%ECONOMY%' AND `part`.`p_type` IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY `part`.`p_type`

WITH brand_revenue AS (
  SELECT 
    p_brand,
    SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS revenue,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) DESC) AS rank
  FROM `samples`.`tpch`.`lineitem` l
  JOIN `samples`.`tpch`.`part` p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey
  WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE('1996-01-01')
    AND l.l_shipdate < DATE('1997-01-01')
    AND l.l_returnflag != 'R'
    AND p.p_brand IS NOT NULL
    AND l.l_shipdate IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY p_brand
)
SELECT p_brand, revenue
FROM brand_revenue
WHERE rank = 1;

SELECT SUM(`lineitem`.`l_extendedprice` * (1 - `lineitem`.`l_discount`)) AS revenue
FROM `samples`.`tpch`.`lineitem`
JOIN `samples`.`tpch`.`supplier` ON `lineitem`.`l_suppkey` = `supplier`.`s_suppkey`
JOIN `samples`.`tpch`.`nation` ON `supplier`.`s_nationkey` = `nation`.`n_nationkey`
WHERE `nation`.`n_name` ILIKE '%JAPAN%'
  AND `lineitem`.`l_returnflag` != 'R'

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(`lineitem`.`l_extendedprice` * (1 - `lineitem`.`l_discount`)), 0) AS revenue FROM `samples`.`tpch`.`customer` JOIN `samples`.`tpch`.`orders` ON `customer`.`c_custkey` = `orders`.`o_custkey` JOIN `samples`.`tpch`.`lineitem` ON `orders`.`o_orderkey` = `lineitem`.`l_orderkey` WHERE `customer`.`c_custkey` = 4242 AND `lineitem`.`l_returnflag` != 'R' AND `lineitem`.`l_shipdate` >= DATE('1996-01-01') AND `lineitem`.`l_shipdate` < DATE('1997-01-01')

SELECT SUM(`l_extendedprice` * (1 - `l_discount`)) AS revenue
FROM `samples`.`tpch`.`lineitem`
WHERE `l_returnflag` = 'R'
  AND `l_shipdate` IS NOT NULL
  AND `l_extendedprice` IS NOT NULL
  AND `l_discount` IS NOT NULL
  AND `l_shipdate` >= DATE('1994-01-01')
  AND `l_shipdate` < DATE('1995-01-01')

SELECT `o_orderpriority`, SUM(`o_totalprice`) AS revenue
FROM `samples`.`tpch`.`orders`
WHERE `o_orderpriority` IS NOT NULL AND `o_totalprice` IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY `o_orderpriority`
ORDER BY revenue DESC

WITH supplier_revenue AS (
  SELECT 
    s.s_suppkey,
    s.s_name,
    SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue
  FROM `samples`.`tpch`.`lineitem` l
  JOIN `samples`.`tpch`.`supplier` s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
  WHERE l.l_returnflag != 'R'
    AND l.l_shipdate >= DATE('1996-01-01')
    AND l.l_shipdate < DATE('1997-01-01')
    AND l.l_suppkey IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name
)
SELECT s_suppkey, s_name, revenue
FROM (
  SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS rank
  FROM supplier_revenue
)
WHERE rank <= 10
ORDER BY revenue DESC

WITH order_revenue AS (
  SELECT 
    `l_orderkey`,
    SUM(`l_extendedprice` * (1 - `l_discount`)) AS order_net_revenue
  FROM `samples`.`tpch`.`lineitem`
  WHERE `l_shipdate` >= DATE('1995-01-01')
    AND `l_shipdate` < DATE('1996-01-01')
    AND `l_returnflag` != 'R'
    AND `l_orderkey` IS NOT NULL
    AND `l_extendedprice` IS NOT NULL
    AND `l_discount` IS NOT NULL
    AND `l_shipdate` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY `l_orderkey`
)
SELECT percentile(order_net_revenue, 0.5) AS median_revenue_per_order_1995
FROM order_revenue;

WITH revenue_by_priority AS (
  SELECT 
    o.o_orderpriority AS order_priority,
    SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS priority_revenue
  FROM `samples`.`tpch`.`lineitem` l
  JOIN `samples`.`tpch`.`orders` o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
  WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE('1997-01-01')
    AND l.l_shipdate < DATE('1998-01-01')
    AND l.l_returnflag != 'R'
    AND l.l_shipdate IS NOT NULL
    AND o.o_orderpriority IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY o.o_orderpriority
),
 total_revenue AS (
  SELECT SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_rev
  FROM `samples`.`tpch`.`lineitem` l
  WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE('1997-01-01')
    AND l.l_shipdate < DATE('1998-01-01')
    AND l.l_returnflag != 'R'
    AND l.l_shipdate IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  r.order_priority,
  100 * (try_divide(r.priority_revenue,t.total_rev)) AS revenue_share
FROM revenue_by_priority r
CROSS JOIN total_revenue t
ORDER BY revenue_share DESC

SELECT AVG(customer_revenue) AS avg_revenue_per_customer
FROM (
  SELECT o.o_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS customer_revenue
  FROM `samples`.`tpch`.`lineitem` l
  JOIN `samples`.`tpch`.`orders` o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
  WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE('1998-01-01')
    AND l.l_shipdate < DATE('1999-01-01')
    AND l.l_returnflag != 'R'
    AND l.l_shipdate IS NOT NULL
    AND l.l_extendedprice IS NOT NULL
    AND l.l_discount IS NOT NULL
    AND o.o_custkey IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY o.o_custkey
)

SELECT `o_orderpriority`, AVG(`o_totalprice`) AS avg_order_total_price
FROM `samples`.`tpch`.`orders`
WHERE `o_orderpriority` IS NOT NULL AND `o_totalprice` IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY `o_orderpriority`
ORDER BY `o_orderpriority`

SELECT `customer`.`c_mktsegment`, COUNT(`orders`.`o_orderkey`) AS order_count
FROM `samples`.`tpch`.`orders` AS orders
JOIN `samples`.`tpch`.`customer` AS customer
  ON `orders`.`o_custkey` = `customer`.`c_custkey`
WHERE `customer`.`c_mktsegment` IS NOT NULL
  AND `orders`.`o_orderdate` >= DATE('1995-01-01')
  AND `orders`.`o_orderdate` < DATE('1996-01-01')
GROUP BY `customer`.`c_mktsegment`

SELECT r_name AS region, SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS revenue
FROM `samples`.`tpch`.`lineitem` l
JOIN `samples`.`tpch`.`orders` o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
JOIN `samples`.`tpch`.`customer` c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
JOIN `samples`.`tpch`.`nation` n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
JOIN `samples`.`tpch`.`region` r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE('1993-01-01')
  AND l.l_shipdate < DATE('1994-01-01')
  AND l.l_returnflag != 'R'
  AND r.r_name IS NOT NULL
  AND l.l_shipdate IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY r.r_name
ORDER BY revenue DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue
FROM `samples`.`tpch`.`lineitem` l
JOIN `samples`.`tpch`.`orders` o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
JOIN `samples`.`tpch`.`customer` c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
JOIN `samples`.`tpch`.`nation` n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
JOIN `samples`.`tpch`.`region` r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE('1993-01-01')
  AND l.l_shipdate < DATE('1994-01-01')
  AND l.l_returnflag != 'R'
  AND o.o_orderpriority ILIKE '%1-URGENT%'
  AND r.r_name IS NOT NULL
  AND l.l_shipdate IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY r.r_name
ORDER BY revenue DESC;

SELECT `l_shipmode`, SUM(`l_extendedprice` * (1 - `l_discount`)) AS revenue
FROM `samples`.`tpch`.`lineitem`
WHERE `l_shipdate` >= DATE('1994-01-01')
  AND `l_shipdate` < DATE('1995-01-01')
  AND `l_returnflag` != 'R'
  AND `l_shipmode` IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY `l_shipmode`
ORDER BY `l_shipmode`

SELECT `l_shipmode`, SUM(`l_extendedprice` * (1 - `l_discount`)) AS revenue
FROM `samples`.`tpch`.`lineitem`
WHERE `l_shipdate` >= DATE('1994-01-01')
  AND `l_shipdate` < DATE('1995-01-01')
  AND `l_shipmode` IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY `l_shipmode`
ORDER BY `l_shipmode`

SELECT part.p_brand, SUM(lineitem.l_extendedprice * (1 - lineitem.l_discount)) AS revenue
FROM samples.tpch.lineitem
JOIN samples.tpch.part ON lineitem.l_partkey = part.p_partkey
WHERE lineitem.l_shipdate IS NOT NULL
  AND part.p_brand IS NOT NULL
  AND lineitem.l_returnflag != 'R'
  AND lineitem.l_shipdate >= DATE('1995-01-01')
  AND lineitem.l_shipdate < DATE('1996-01-01')
GROUP BY part.p_brand
ORDER BY revenue DESC

SELECT part.p_brand, nation.n_name AS supplier_nation, SUM(lineitem.l_extendedprice * (1 - lineitem.l_discount)) AS revenue
FROM samples.tpch.lineitem
JOIN samples.tpch.part ON lineitem.l_partkey = part.p_partkey
JOIN samples.tpch.supplier ON lineitem.l_suppkey = supplier.s_suppkey
JOIN samples.tpch.nation ON supplier.s_nationkey = nation.n_nationkey
WHERE lineitem.l_shipdate IS NOT NULL
  AND part.p_brand IS NOT NULL
  AND nation.n_name IS NOT NULL
  AND lineitem.l_returnflag != 'R'
  AND lineitem.l_shipdate >= DATE('1995-01-01')
  AND lineitem.l_shipdate < DATE('1996-01-01')
GROUP BY part.p_brand, nation.n_name
ORDER BY revenue DESC

SELECT o_year, SUM(CASE WHEN nation = 'BRAZIL' THEN volume ELSE 0 END) / SUM(volume) AS mkt_share
FROM (
  SELECT YEAR(o_orderdate) AS o_year, l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) AS volume, n2.n_name AS nation
  FROM samples.tpch.part, samples.tpch.supplier, samples.tpch.lineitem, samples.tpch.orders,
       samples.tpch.customer, samples.tpch.nation n1, samples.tpch.nation n2, samples.tpch.region
  WHERE p_partkey = l_partkey AND s_suppkey = l_suppkey AND l_orderkey = o_orderkey AND o_custkey = c_custkey
    AND c_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey AND n1.n_regionkey = r_regionkey AND r_name = 'AMERICA'
    AND s_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey AND o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1995-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31'
    AND p_type = 'ECONOMY ANODIZED STEEL') AS all_nations
GROUP BY o_year ORDER BY o_year

SELECT nation, o_year, SUM(amount) AS sum_profit
FROM (
  SELECT n_name AS nation, YEAR(o_orderdate) AS o_year,
         l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) - ps_supplycost * l_quantity AS amount
  FROM samples.tpch.part, samples.tpch.supplier, samples.tpch.lineitem, samples.tpch.partsupp,
       samples.tpch.orders, samples.tpch.nation
  WHERE s_suppkey = l_suppkey AND ps_suppkey = l_suppkey AND ps_partkey = l_partkey AND p_partkey = l_partkey
    AND o_orderkey = l_orderkey AND s_nationkey = n_nationkey AND p_name LIKE '%green%') AS profit
GROUP BY nation, o_year ORDER BY nation, o_year DESC

WITH revenue0 AS (
  SELECT l_suppkey AS supplier_no, SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS total_revenue
  FROM samples.tpch.lineitem
  WHERE l_shipdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND l_shipdate < DATE '1996-04-01'
  GROUP BY l_suppkey)
SELECT s_suppkey, s_name, s_address, s_phone, total_revenue
FROM samples.tpch.supplier, revenue0
WHERE s_suppkey = supplier_no AND total_revenue = (SELECT MAX(total_revenue) FROM revenue0)
ORDER BY s_suppkey
